title: Why a Name Makes Something Easier to Notice
short_teaser: Once we learn a name for a plant, pattern, emotion, or behavior, we often begin seeing it more frequently.
story: Once we learn a name for a plant, pattern, emotion, or behavior, we often begin seeing it more frequently. The word creates a mental category for recognition. Language can change perception by giving attention a place to land. Curiosity loosens assumptions. A better question can reveal options that certainty would have hidden. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Language can change perception by giving attention a place to land. Curiosity loosens assumptions. A better question can reveal options that certainty would have hidden.
spark_application: Take one assumption you have been treating as fixed and turn it into three open questions. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
